name: omniroute
description: Route work through an authenticated local OmniRoute daemon with exact model attribution.
long_description: OmniRoute uses OpenAI/gpt-5.6-sol as a validated routing planner, executes explicitly selected workers, and returns provider/model attribution. The extension talks only to the user's loopback OmniRoute daemon and stores no provider credentials.

tools.name: omni_route
tools.description: Route a task and return attributed output.
